definitions.gloss: rose-colored; rosy; bright (of a future or life)
definitions.explanation: The pink color of roses, and above all, figuratively, full of hope and happiness. Often used ironically or in the negative: life is not all roses.

examples.japanese: バラ{色|いろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧。
⟦{未来|みらい}→未来：03748_mirai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧バラ{色|いろ}だ。

⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦すれば→する：00392_suru⟧バラ{色|いろ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{待|ま}っている→待つ：00469_matsu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}っていた→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、そう⟦{甘|あま}くなかった→甘い：00617_amai⟧。
examples.english: I thought rosy days would be waiting once I married, but it wasn't that easy.

notes:
Also written {薔薇色|ばらいろ}.
